info.name: Tsukasa Tenma
info.sexuality: "Pansexual" (actually homosexual because Rui was his gay awakening)
info.housing: Southern Glen, Block #3, 307 w/ Rui Kamishiro
info.guilds: Children of the Stars, Search and Rescue, and Lorekeepers
info.jobs: Actor @ Solaria Opera House, Part-time worker @ Last Stitches
info.goals: To stay with Rui until the curtain call.
info.personality:
Tsukasa has a rather energetic and bright personality that people at first glance might call obnoxiously loud and strange. He has a habit of showing off to express himself that often gives secondhand embarrassment to others like his sister. He can be a little egocentric, when he gets too absorbed in his goal of becoming a star, but his friends helped him realize how much he loves performing and through performances, his charisma and radiance truly shines.

The intensity of his personality comes from his strong passion for acting, desiring to grow much more as an actor through each show and role he performs. Though Tsukasa can be a little silly at times, he is a reliable and diligent person who studies the character given to him deeply and practices his role until he feels satisfied. However, he has a tendency to overwork himself when his vision becomes too narrow and he gets obsessed with trying to achieve a certain result. When issues like that come for him, he will remain open-minded and take any advice others give him to apply to his acting, helping him achieve breakthroughs.

He has exceptional faith in his troupe members and believes in them, despite some initial misgivings he may have. The bond he has with them serves a reminder to him about his feelings to make people happy by putting on a fantastic show.
trivia: He spent all the money he had on him upon coming to Solasta, to buy a piano that barely fits in his apartment because it feels wrong to him not to have one.
He spent all the money he had on him upon coming to Solasta, to buy a piano that barely fits in his apartment because it feels wrong to him not to have one.

Adopted a male Sun Conure for a pet and his name is Crimson Starlet Phoenix Tenma (Crimson Phenny for short) and a male Green-Cheeked Conure with a violet color mutation named Rainbow Miracle Wonder Kamishiro
Sparring with Ithaqua often for training
He's very good with all manners of managing the household now
Wears a matching choker with his significant other

plotting.preferred_areas: Can be found almost anywhere but his current favorite go-to places are: Fortuna Association, Last Stitches, Dynamic Designs, Imaginarium Theatre, Solasta Opera House, Blue Ridge Mall, Moonlight Borough
plotting.interaction_notes: Tsukasa has the energy between an Abyssinian cat and a Shiba Inu, so please be mindful he's extremely social and loud and maybe overdramatic at times! He's a bit of a busybody so he tends to reach out to people. (And honestly I would love to put him more out there.)
plotting.shipping: Tsukasa is closed for shipping. He is completely devoted to his director and moon, Rui Kamishiro.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Tsukasa is 18. Can partake in discussion of topics but exclusive to partner only.
plotting_hooks: Meeting Tsukasa at Last Stitches, his other part-time job. He can repair any tears and strike up a conversation about fashion.
Mall. He’s always looking for new places to explore so he can go with his partner or friend in the future.
Training. (He’s a Guardian/Navigator). He is very dedicated to keeping his body in shape and keeping up with classes.
Tokusatsu club. Heroes greatly interest him and he also likes learning about the production process behind a hero show.
Piano! Sometimes, Tsukasa may ask the owner if he could play on it for a bit. He will happily talk about the piano.
Plushies! He can be found in shops that sell plushies or make them.
Street performance! He and Rui have a habit of performing guerilla shows. He will happily talk about shows.
Opera House! He's working on several scripts of his own. Again, he will happily talk about shows and probably also have a deeper conversation about production.
Paws Rising. He recently got another pet bird so he's always looking for advice on how to raise his birb sons.
Reaching out to him indirectly by Rui or other friends
Reaching out to him for romantic advice whether it's him asking or asking him. (I promise he gives solid advice most of the time…)
Talking about siblings with him. He really misses his siblings!!

relationships.name: Rui Kamishiro
relationships.description:
If the end
Of the world arrived now,
Then I would leave everything behind
And the two of us would be together forever

info.name: Caelus
info.goals: To return back to the Astral Express(?)
info.personality:
At first glance, Caelus seems like a calm and collected individual. In most situations and combat, he can be a rational thinker and is not afraid to take charge. He is also capable of negotiating in order to win a debate. Unfortunately, when he is presented with set choices he needs to make, he tends to make the bolder and riskier choices... which half the time is resolved by combat.

Underneath his calm exterior, Caelus embodies the spirit of the Trailblaze, having the explorer’s heart to interact with everything… trash cans included. He also tries to reap rewards any time he can, even if he appears to look shameless. Some of these interactions are quite questionable that his allies can be quite exasperated with him. He also has the penchant to make bad jokes and whenever the opportunity arises, he will flex himself. Nevertheless, he is quite social and likes holding conversations with his friends, going over various topics or trends that mutually share his interests. He looks out for his allies and gives his moral support whenever they need it.

And most importantly, he will absolutely never back down from a challenge, as serious or even silly as it can be. To be a Trailblazer, is to forge ahead undaunted.
trivia: He has two pets; a miniature pig named Ivory Menace and a giant Flemish rabbit named Pom-Pom Jr. One has a destructive personality with their cuteness, the other is a refined scholar who will silently judge Caelus if he touches the TV remote
Everyone is telling him to train Ivory Menace and regain control of his household, but unfortunately there’s dwindling hope that will happen
Sleeps in a cardboard box most of the time. Mostly because Ivory Menace took the bed and Pom-Pom Jr took the couch.
While he’s been able to suppress it deep down since his first trial, recent events has made his nihilism creep up a tiny bit again

plotting.preferred_areas: Anywhere, especially areas with trash, but his current favorite go-to places are: Bathaus
plotting.interaction_notes: Caelus is a bit of a wildcard. He can have a decent conversation, but likes teasing and ragebaiting (sometimes it's unintentional even) if the opportunity arises. But he has no mean-spirited intentions and is very open to debates and philosophical conversations.
plotting.shipping: Available, but due to his sexuality, it takes a while for him to form an emotional bond before proceeding to romance
plotting.nsfw: ❓ - Limited. Caelus is 18+ so he's fine with the discussion of topics. However, he's not comfortable imagining himself in situations, so this may take him a bit even with a romantic partner.
plotting_hooks: Trash. Unfortunately, he's an actual raccoon and you'll often find him scavenging the trash with his trash can cat.
Pets. He adores his giant Flemish rabbit Pom-Pom Jr and miniature pig Ivory Menace so much even if he’s on the bottom of the pecking order. He finds his trash cake cat Astral a menace though.
Training. He is always down for sparring and may show off his other path skills.
Gaming. Same with training, he's always down for a good gaming session locally or online, whether it's PvP or Co-op. He also likes classical board games too.
Bats. Oh glorious bats. Of course, the Galactic Baseballer has fashioned himself as a connoisseur to them, so he will always be down to talk about them.
Selfies. Caelus is but a vain creature who likes taking images at the most opportune and inopportune time. Want to take a shot with him?
Astral Express. He's always down to talk about his journeys and the cool and stupid things he’s done.
Cartoons. He really likes classical cartoons like Clockie and Hanu. Always up for chatting about it.
Automobiles. Want a ride on the Trashinator?

info.name: Natsume Sakasaki
info.housing: Rose Point, Townhouse #1 w/ Mao Isara
info.personality:
Natsume is a tricky boy who relies on his wits and intelligence to adapt to various situations. He usually works behind the scenes to tactfully gain benefits for himself and his unit. He can also be quite petty and those who mock or wrong him will earn a grudge for a long time.

While he is called a genius and acts like one, in actuality, he works very hard and desperately to catch up to those he admires, the other four Eccentrics. However, time and time again, he feels he’s still inferior to them and wishes to overcome his weakness, especially after they sacrificed their reputations to protect him. Due to this, he can lose his way when his heart wavers and place burdens on his own heart.

Natsume can act quite mysterious and at times quite capricious, but it’s really to hide his true feelings. This is especially the case for when he’s being kind but refuses to say so until someone points it out. Nevertheless, Natsume is very empathetic and has a desire to protect the weaker and the outcasts, being in the same position once. To that end, he will cling to his ideals of being a magician to write the pages of a new story for his audience. Isn’t that what happy endings are for?
trivia: Growing a small indoor garden, still debating if he needs to move it outdoors anywhere
Has recently adopted two kittens named Apollo and Artemis

plotting.preferred_areas: His current favorite go-to places are: Haunted Oddities, Blue Ridge Mall, Moonlight Borough, Catpuccino, Wrench & Win, Australe Observatory
plotting.interaction_notes: Natsume is pretty careful in his interactions, which often paints him a bit shady, but he means well. Sometimes he can be more earnest depending on the situation. Do note, he does have a really sharp tongue if upset.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Natsume is 18+. Can partake in discussion of topics but exclusive to partner only.
plotting_hooks: Fortune telling. He's always up for reading people’s fortunes and will give some decent advice. Typically, he can be found in the Bazaar for that on the occasion he opens shop.
Magic. He loves performing magic to people on a whim. You might catch him doing tricks on his own sometime.
Training. Sometimes he can be found training at the Training Hall.
Finding him on his job. He can be interacted with while working, whether you’re his coworker or customer.

Finding him in the middle of his experiments. Sometimes, he'll be conducting outdoor experiments if he's not closed up in his room. His experiments are generally safe, because he would rather not get in trouble. His experiments aren't limited to chemical reactions, as he likes to tinker with broken things to fix them too.
Rare, wild Pokemon encounter at the Solasta Education Center. Specifically to use the science labs and trying to procure some chemicals and materials.
Gaming or entertainment facilities. He's a gamer himself so places like Skill Points and Cipher34 highly interest him. He’s also online a lot in the Gamer's club.
Gardening. It’s one of his hobbies so he'll be in places related to that, like the Moonlight Borough.
Cats. He loves cats. He has two cats: Artemis and Apollo and he can be found sometimes at Catpuccino.
Idols. It's a bit of a sore topic for him because he’s missing Switch, but he will gladly give idol-related advice or talk about his experience.
Staging. He was in charge of Switch's production and was a part of the theatrical troupe Dramatica, so he has much knowledge in regards to that.

info.name: Howan
info.housing: Lilac Lane, Block #1 w/ Kiana Kaslana
info.jobs: Server @ Blue Ridge Mall Food Court, Helper @ Hazelnut Fields
info.personality:
Howan is a sweet, optimistic girl who is also quite adventurous. Her upbringing in the countryside raised her to be a diligent and hardworking person, as well knowing to be grateful to the bountiful harvests and her community. Stories and interactions with her grandmother gave her a bold and curious nature, which sparked her dream to go to Midi City. She loves music and treasures her guitar and friends dearly. However, she does not come without her flaws.

She is quite gullible with her naïveté of the city, where once she almost had herself legally bound to a contract forever. She is also quite clumsy in new environments and need to take a bit of time to learn to adjust herself. Her time management can be a little disorganized when it comes to part-time jobs.

Howan can also be very oblivious, not realizing her friend's feelings until later. However, she is open to communication and will seek out to address their problems, making her very easy to talk to. Her innocent heart and desire to reach out to others wins out people's hearts.

And most importantly, her greatest strength is not giving up her dream and doing what she loves to do: performing music!
trivia: Named the Will-o-wisps Rui gave her during the expedition ‘Mashima’ and ‘Himeko’
Likes practicing her guitar outside at Moonlight Borough when it’s sunny
Designated Masamune and Michinaga as Cool Big Bro #1 and Cool Big Bro #2
Cherishes her friendship with Night Watch

plotting.preferred_areas: Anywhere, especially music-oriented, but her current favorite go-to places are: Imaginarium Theatre, Moonlight Borough
plotting.interaction_notes: Very social and happy to interact with others!! She is an Artic Fox Myumon, so her mannerisms come off quite affectionate and playful. She's a bit slow to understand things, but everything she says comes from the heart and she easily trusts people.
plotting.shipping: Unavailable, Howan is heavily implied to be dating Mashima Himeko at her canon point, therefore she is closed to relationships.
plotting.nsfw: ❌ - Howan is listed 18, but I strongly feel she doesn't have the maturity to partake in these topics.
plotting_hooks: Music!! You can find her in places anywhere related to music or her performing a street live. She will happily talk about songs, composing, and her band.
Guitar/Instruments. Similarly, you can find her in places related to music, but she has knowledge about the guitar especially, though her way of talking about them is less on the technical side…
Training. She’s been steadily practicing with her new weapon since she ranked up, and she will appreciate help on that.
City. Howan’s from the countryside but she loves exploring new places in the big city and will happily ask for guidance.
Classes. She’s a Nurse/Forager. She will happily help out and give advice as a nurse, but she would love to receive advice back as well as on her Forager subclass.
Farming. She grew up in a farming village, so she loves to volunteer helping out at Hazelnut Fields.
Homeland. Curious about her fox ears and tail? She would be glad to talk in detail about Midi City and its citizens
Cooking. She loves cooking and is always on the search for new recipes, especially trendy ones in the city!
Housework. Like cooking, Howan is extremely comfortable with housework and can offer to help out!

relationships.name: Ithaqua
relationships.description: A cherished friend, who always looks after her. He may think he's a monster, but she sees under his mask for who he is.

info.name: Sakichi Ishida
info.housing: Lilac Lane, Block #2 w/ Nikki, Belle, and Polyxia
info.goals: To remain here and become an ideal leader
info.personality:
Sakichi is a straightforward and blunt young man, unafraid to be direct and speak out his thoughts. Due to his stiff personality, he has earned animosity around him, making many enemies and only having a few friends. However, despite his shortcomings, he is very clever and resourceful, and especially determined to carry out his tasks no matter what strife he must go through. This determination also makes him rather bold and reckless, and while many have noted him to be ‘an inexperienced, but idealistic fool’, some can’t help but be charmed by his purity and honorable nature, wanting to support him.

Sakichi believes the most that heroes could change the world and wishes his name could go down like that. However, he doesn’t have confidence in himself as a leader as he knows he is disliked by many, but tries his best to grow more on his journey to be able to build more alliances and friendships.

He is fervently loyal and protective to those he cares about: his master Hideyoshi, who influenced his own ideals of how to change the world, and his strong bond with the Kumou twins, who lit his desire to make his ideal world to become one without war.
trivia: He named the water horse he caught on his first expedition as “Suiren”
He respects his roommates and often gets up early to make their meals if he can.
Finally understood how an electric rice cooker works.
His personal mementos are a cloud pattern fan and an ornate pipe. Strangely, he had them on him when he arrived here, knowing who their owners were...
Owns two black twin cats named Baren and Okuni

plotting.preferred_areas: His current go-to places are: City Hall, Fortuna Association, Moonlight Borough
plotting.interaction_notes: He is very reserved and formal, being a traditional Japanese samurai. However, he is surprisingly progressive and would genuinely love to learn new ways to live and enjoy life. Things that are nostalgic to him make him feel joy.
plotting.shipping: Unavailable, Sakichi is closed for relationships. Before his death, he was allowed into the Kumou family as a ‘son-in-law’ with Okuni as his wife. He also had a relationship with her twin brother Baren.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Sakichi is 18+. Discussion of topics and jokes are fine with him, though it may irritate him. He is uninterested in anything else.
plotting_hooks: Training. He takes training seriously and even though he’s a Navigator he doesn’t wish to slack off on his swordsmanship. He is also trying to improve using a gun.
Swords. While he is by no means an expert, his eye is well trained enough to discern swords and he would engage in conversation about forges and fighting styles.

Tea. He’s used to serving tea to his lord before, so he’s well versed in tea ceremonies. While he’s used to the traditional tea served back home, he is open to learning more about new flavors and styles of tea.
Modern day trends/Technology. He is unfortunately behind the times, so he would be grateful to learn more about the modern day and technology.
Horses. He really likes horses, especially his water horse and the one he left back home.
Cats. Owner of two tricky mischievous cats, Okuni and Baren. He often takes them out to play or they’ll cause a mess in his house.

relationships.name: Nikki
relationships.description: One of his roommates, whom he looks after like the little sister he never had.

info.name: Yosuke Hanamura
info.sexuality: Closeted homosexual that’s not really in denial anymore. Probably.
info.jobs: General Manager at Twilight Pass (Night Shift)
info.goals: To return back to the Investigation Team and stop the tournament
info.personality:
Yosuke is a pretty friendly and casual guy, with a tendency to act like wannabe casanova. However, he tends to get in trouble with his foot-in-mouth syndrome, his insensitive remarks often earning him the ire of friends. Despite struggling to get motivated with his studies, he is quite intelligent and is often the second opinion the protagonist will turn to when deducing cases.

His cheerfulness used to be a facade for him to fit in with his peers when he first moved into Inaba, fully aware that people were talking about him behind his back. He hid that spitefulness and boredom for the countryside deep in his heart, until he was forced to face himself during the investigation of Saki Konishi’s death, a girl whom he had feelings for.

Being able to overcome himself, Yosuke is able to become more honest and acknowledge his flaws. The death of Saki weighs heavily on his mind and it becomes the foundation of his strong sense of justice. But due to that, he can be conflicted by his own emotions when faced with the moral choice of killing the supposed murderer or not. He also often worries his own boredom and desire for excitement in his life would bring back his shadow one day.
trivia: He took the night shift for Twilight pass from 9pm - 6am so he could take it more easy, but he’s starting to regret his choices
Absolutely terrified walking out in public now and getting spotted by the people who greeted him first in Solasta. I mean who wouldn’t be when you get threatened to be tossed in a tornado--

plotting.preferred_areas: Mostly places around the city, but his current go-to places are: Twilight Pass, Dynamic Designs, Blue Ridge Mall
plotting.interaction_notes: Pretty social, but in the customer service kind of way. He can easily talk to strangers but given the nature of the city, he’s a bit reserved and cautious though has a tendency to say the wrong thing. When he loosens up, he’s very chill. Celebrities are a different story.
plotting.shipping: Available and fine with polyamorous relationships
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Yosuke is 18+. Can partake in discussion of topics but exclusive to partner only.
plotting_hooks: Music. He likes collecting CDs of music he likes, especially western music.
Idols. He’s an absolute idol fan and has been observing Dreamweaver Talent like a hawk. If you mention it to him though, he’ll get extremely embarrassed.
Fashion. He’s always looking at the latest fashion trends and new accessories to wear, like headphones or bracelets.
Classes. He’s actually still deciding on his subclass so having a conversation about classes and expeditions might enlighten him to choose a subclass.
Personas. As a Persona user, the topic of Personas heavily interests him, especially learning there are other Persona users out there.
Job. If you’d like to lend an ear he is always bemoaning about his night shift at Twilight Pass.
Mall. Lately he’s been interested in exploring places at the mall, especially the night clubs when he can get a day off.

info.name: Brynhildr Vilulf
info.housing: Southern Glen, Block #2, 204 w/ Ritsu Sakuma
info.classes: <s>Navigator</s> Forager (This muse has changed classes due to lore reasons)
info.goals: To return to the living and kill that traitor.
info.personality:
Brynhildr has a free-spirited and unpredictable spirit, unrestrained by limitations set on her. She was beloved by her fellow clansmen, but she often clashed with her eldest brother who was more rational and rigid. Like much of the Vilulf, she was quite proud of her heritage, being the granddaughter of 'Redbeard' and the daughter of Lagertha.

Aspiring to be just like her mother, Brynhildr inherited her courage and tenacity, eventually proving to her that she had the strength to become a captain after dedicating years to her craft. However, after she became a captain, her recklessness earned her trouble with the law. Furthermore, her naivety and carelessness failed to prepare her for the inevitable betrayal by her own brother that led to the massacre of their clan by the naval fleet's hands. For the first time in her life, she questioned her own birth and if she truly deserved to have been born.

After witnessing the destruction of her clan and her mother dying in the blizzard to protect her, Brynhildr changed forever. She could no longer live wildly or happily. Her reliance on alcohol became worse to cope with all the deaths, and her thoughts became muddled between dream and reality. The only thing that she could remember rationally and with fury, was that she needed to kill the traitor.
trivia: She does not remember her death, but she does have fragmented memories of her dreams and delusions during the ‘Behold the Vilulf’ event.

plotting.preferred_areas: Her current go-to places: Lake Tycho, Bellflower Medical, Cap'n's Cove
plotting.interaction_notes: Typically she's very social, but since coming back from her trial has taken away something important from her, so she's a little more lifeless than how she was originally was. Still loud and boisterous.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Brynhildr is 18+. Can partake in discussion of topics but would not mind flings.
plotting_hooks: Expedition. If anyone would like to check in on her after her revival, she would be surprised, but does not mind visitors. This includes people who didn't go on the expedition.
Drinking. She would be down for a drink if she's allowed upon her return and discharge from the hospital.
Pirates. If she has the energy to, she'll yap on about her adventures as a pirate.
Sea. She may not travel across anymore, but she still likes watching the sea. She's also a very good swimmer
Family. Curious to know about the Vilulfs? She'll gladly talk about her clan and their history.

relationships.name: Ithaqua
relationships.description: They might be generations apart and lived in completely different worlds, but maybe he's a Vilulf too... He reminds him of that person.

info.name: Idia Shroud
info.personality:
Offline, Idia gives the impression of an inept and pathetic boy with zero social skills whatsoever. He is naturally anxious to be around other people and rejects nearly every offer to hang out with anyone, especially those he labels as extroverts. His communication skills are so poor that he frequently uses a tablet to speak in his place when he has to. However, when he does have the chance to speak with others in person, he can be rather candid and mean-spirited which makes him highly dislikeable. He can also be extremely petty and cling on to a grudge for a very long time. When he becomes enraged, his blue hair becomes a burning bright red.

Online, he tends to be more social, as he is empowered by anonymity and makes sure no one can dig into his private life. Though he prefers to solo alone, he can become attached to a few friends he has made online such as his online companion Muscle Red. He is extremely dedicated to the grinding of his games and will suffer without having internet. He is also a completely passionate otaku and will go on a tirade about his fixations before he stops himself from inflicting self-humiliation.

His gloomy personality aside, Idia is remarkably known for his high intelligence with magic and technology, having built and perfected a security system for his family's research organization and made several advancements. He also displays a high amount of diligence to build the android Ortho, despite going through his grief and borderline insanity from his survivor's guilt.
trivia: If I had a nickel for every time I have to add to his cringe compilation, I would be filthy rich.
He writes magical girl fanfiction. It has to be canon.
Gummy worms are the most superior junk food. No questions asked.

plotting.preferred_areas: His current go-to places at specific hours are: Wondercade, Skill Points, Twilight Pass. Otherwise he's nearly home always at Honeydew Point. Currently wants to go to Catpuccino but his social anxiety says no.
plotting.interaction_notes: He has not chosen to reveal his offline identity so he goes by Charon or Gloomurai online, so please refer to him as those aliases UNLESS muse has access to his information or has met him offline and confirmed his identity. He has a preference for DMs, but can be found in the above locations during the night most of the time. Of course, he’s very skittish but he can interact under circumstances and if he has his tablet.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Idia is 18. Can partake in discussion of topics but exclusive to partner only.
plotting_hooks: Gaming. Best way to communicate with Idia. His love for games has no bounds.
Programming. He works for City Hall remotely from home, but he can be contacted by coworkers.
Neighbors. Hypothetically, one can do a well-being check on him as a neighbor…
Cats. He loves cats so much but he’s too scared to go to Catpuccino. Cats are scared of him though because he’s so freaky baby-talking them.
Idols/Anime/Otaku things. If you don’t mind his autism going off essays about his hyperfixations, then it’s a point of engagement for him.
Horror movies. Same as otaku things, except he’s either more critical or fanatical about movies.
Robotics. A sore point for him, but he is highly intelligent in this field and maybe with a bit of encouragement, he can hold a discussion.
Magic. Also a sore point for him but to less of a degree. He can talk about the fundamentals of magic and technology involved.
Fanfiction. If you somehow managed to find his written fanfics of the class leaders THIS IS TOP SECRET!!!

info.name: Cipher
info.jobs: Courier @ Midtown Express, Part-time Waiter @ Catpuccino
info.goals: Start over a new leaf and have fun
info.personality:
Her factor was modeled after the path of Elation, thus Cipher chooses to live freely and steal anything that fancy her whimsy. She has an unrestrained and daring personality that allows him to brave each heist she draws to steal. She is relentless in obtaining the things he wants, even patiently waiting for months in disguise as a priest to steal a valuable treasure in the Dawncloud. Being the Demigod of Trickery, his lies are so convincing it even becomes the truth with her powers. However, she does not choose to use her trickery to inflict evil, instead for using it for the occasional mischief and usually for her veiled chivalry to help the poor and misfortunate.

Despite posing a jaded attitude towards the responsibility of a Chrysos Heir, Cipher holds her duty seriously, upholding his promise to Phainon to protect the Worldbearing Coreflame, even as the cost of her life. To this day, she holds deep regret in her heart having to leave Okhema behind, because of the grand lie that he constructed to protect the holy city. While he can hide her emotions carefully, there are those she doesn't wish to see behind her lies, to see his vulnerabilities of being around the people she loved, instead of constantly running away.
trivia: Interchangeable pronouns to her/his mood (though she really prefers being called Lord Cipher rather than Lady Cipher)

plotting.preferred_areas: Anywhere, since she’s new to Solasta. His current go-to places are: Midtown Express, the Bazaar, Catpuccino.
plotting.interaction_notes: She’s very social but he has a silver tongue so be careful with your wallet! She’s less prone to stealing now but it doesn’t mean she won’t manipulate you to spend on him. However, the money does go towards more toys and treats for the cats at the Catpuccino.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Cipher is 18+. Can partake in discussion of topics but would definitely not mind flings.
plotting_hooks: Cats. Works at the Catpuccino and being a catgirl herself, she really likes cats.
Speed. Be careful if you choose to race him.
Mischief. Being the Demigod of Trickery, she really likes to get up to trouble, so count her in for any pranks!
Pickpocketing. Well, she won't actively rob stores or vendors but she may occasionally pickpocket people to his whimsy.
Chrysos Heir. She’s always welcome to interact with her fellow Chrysos Heirs, though they're not going to fix her habits much.
Gaming and Puzzles. He loves games and puzzles, from playing to making puzzles like leaving clues to decipher for things she happens to steal and have yet to return.
Disguise. There's a chance he or she might disguise herself for fun. If discussed ahead of time, she can disguise as you to cause some mischief.

info.name: Luca Balsa
info.personality:
Before the accident, Luca had been a kind and trusting person. He admired his teacher Alva Lorenz with all his heart, even likening himself as “Lorenz Junior”, thinking Alva like a father to him over his own despised one, Herman Balsa, who left him and his mother during childhood. However, he became infuriated upon learning the truth of what happened between Alva and his father, and that Alva had retained some of Herman's manuscripts. Overcome by rage with the thought, he recklessly attacked his mentor, leading to his ill-fated experiment to explode during the fight.

Now Luca is left a shell of himself after the accident, having little memories and severe and chronic headaches that cause him much pain. He also became traumatized from his time being incarcerated. Despite losing so much and his thinking processes being severely diminished, Luca still maintains his pride, intelligence and curiosity as inventor. He becomes relentless whenever he encounters something new to discover its inner workings, even if it may be risky to do so. When Luca is so focused on something, he becomes less aware of his surroundings, making him susceptible to danger. But he is willing to take on those risks, because he has nothing to lose.

And finally, the most important trait that makes Luca unique, is his obsession with his invention. No matter what, nor the cost of it, he is determined to see that he completes his life's work, never turning back.
trivia: His headaches come at random, but especially triggered with loud constant noises

plotting.preferred_areas: Wrench & Win, The Hearth, anywhere not loud!
plotting.interaction_notes: He's sociable within reason, especially once you start talking about things that catch his interest.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Luca is 18+. Can partake in discussion of topics.
plotting_hooks: Expedition. He's quite interested in discussing about recent expeditions.
Inventions. Fair warning, he has an itch to dismantle things. Either he will be deadly silent focused on things, or he will not shut up, yapping away about a multitude of things!
His condition. Due to the incident, he's prone to headaches and losing his foothold at times. Also may or may not electrify you.

info.name: Rutile Flores
info.housing: Southern Glen, Block #3, 301 w/ Sylvain Jose Gautier
info.goals: Revive and return to Mitile and the Sage’s wizards
info.personality:
Rutile has a gentle and amicable personality, warm to everyone he meets. He gets along with people very easily, having no issue befriending others no matter who, as he tries to see the good in people, even if it may be hard to see. As a teacher and older brother, he is encouraging to those around and provides guidance and wisdom when he can, especially to the younger ones. He is also extremely passionate about art, often painting or drawing abstract things when he feels inspired.

Coming from the Southern Country, he feels strongly that humans and wizards should get along with one another, his proof being his mother having been a witch and his father, a human, loved each other, as well as the Town of Clouds who supported him and Mitile. To that end, Rutile can be incredibly stubborn about his values and ideals, sometimes putting him at odds with Mithra. He cherishes life deeply, having watched the people close to him die, and it is for that reason he cannot bring himself to eat a mana stone, even if it would make him stronger. But when it comes to his brother, he doesn't wish to force those ideals on him, wanting Mitile to grow freely. People have noted when Rutile is similar to his mother in some aspects, like his appearance and the way he smiles.
trivia: He currently has Rui’s Little Lion Dance Robot on loan as a companion and treats it similar to a cat!
He's making a picture book of his experiences in Solasta.

plotting.preferred_areas: Solasta Education Center, Lake Tycho, The Hearth, almost anywhere
plotting.interaction_notes: Rutile is incredibly social and will easily start a conversation with anyone! He has no sense of danger whatsoever.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Rutile is 18+. Can partake in discussion of topics but exclusive to partner only.
plotting_hooks: Teaching. Rutile is a teacher and would be happy to teach things or give additional lessons to help.
Magic. While he may not be a strong wizard, he can perform basic magic and demonstrate. He can also fly very fast on his broom!!
Flying. Like magic, he can demonstrate his flying and even offer a ride! Be careful not to fall off!
Family. He loves talking about his family, especially his little brother.
Painting. He's always looking for inspiration to paint or draw vividly abstract things.

info.name: Iroha Sakayori
info.jobs: Producer / Composer @ Dreamweaver Talent, Part-time Waitress @ Rosewood Eats
info.goals: Has not decided anything yet, but she wants Yachiyo and Kaguya to be happy
info.personality:
Outwardly, Iroha is the picture of a model honors student and an extremely hard worker that her classmates and co-workers respect. However, despite garnering respect from her peers, she has low confidence in herself and her selfless nature makes her easy to push over. It is for that reason she left her overbearing mother to live on her own, wishing to prove something to her. She dislikes being alone, but quickly matured after living by herself to set up her own priorities and responsibilities. The strictness and diligence she imposes on herself leaves her so fatigued at times, but she was able to foster her own sense of independence as a result.

However, that same sense of independence made her hesitant to depend on other people, keeping her problems to herself even if she would collapse from being sick. She easily gets stressed when she's thrown off her routine, especially by Kaguya, but finds herself fond of her companion, unable to say no to her requests because she's too selfless. Iroha has a different side when it comes to going online in Tsukuyomi. She enjoys playing games hardcore and she is an extremely dedicated fan of Yachiyo Runami, always watching her streams and having a little shrine and merch of her.
trivia: She’s intending to wear the fursuit for most activities, which includes livestreams and training as a guardian.

plotting.preferred_areas: Dreamweaver Talent, Rosewood Eats, Eternal Peace Bakery
plotting.interaction_notes: Iroha can be a bit finicky at first, even hiding behind her fox costume if she feels overwhelmed or nervous, especially in a huge crowd. She does first and foremost puts on her honor student/customer service face to strangers she doesn't know yet on one-on-one level.
plotting.shipping: Iroha is closed for shipping as she is planned with Kaguya and Yachiyo.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Iroha is 18. Can partake in discussion of topics but exclusive to partners only.
plotting_hooks: Fox suit. She's trying to be so inconspicious but that's not working in her favor.
Composing. She's a songwriter who recently started writing again. She would love to have discussions about music to better the quality of her work.
Music. On the same note as composing, she likes playing the piano and would not mind talking about it or playing a few pieces.
Gaming. She's actually a hardcore gamer, but tries to play it off that she's casual. Her aim rate in shooters is at least 90%.
Producing. She's Kaguya's producer who also collaborates a lot with Yachiyo. Interested in collaborating with Kaguya? You need to go through her.
Idols. On the same note, she's a very passionate fan for her idol and streamer Yachiyo and may go into emotional fits.

relationships.name: Yachiyo
relationships.description: You were always there by my side since the beginning.
